children: The S&P 500 edged up 0.1%, while the Dow Jones gained nearly 100 points and the Nasdaq hovered around the flatline on Wednesday, as markets delivered a mixed reaction to the FOMC decision.
As expected, the Fed left interest rates unchanged, although two policymakers dissented in favor of a 25bps rate hike.
The central bank offered no forward guidance, while investors continued to price in a nearly 90% probability of a rate hike in December, little changed from before the announcement.
Meanwhile, corporate earnings remained in focus.
Microsoft (-0.8%) and Alphabet (+1.2%) are due to report results after the closing bell.
Alphabet also benefitted from news that OpenAI intends to buy AI computing chips from Google.
Record quarterly profits from South Korea’s SK Hynix also boosted some semicon stocks including Micron Technology (4.2%) and AMD (1.6%).
In contrast, Apple fell 0.5% despite unveiling a revamped MacBook Pro featuring a touchscreen.
Meta went down 1.6% and Tesla fell 1.4%.

title: US Stocks Mixed After Fed
